thread:
Alex Chen: Ran into an odd mismatch in the console cost/latency snippet PR #789 — the Go SDK example shows `TraceContext` being passed as `trace_id` instead of `trace_id_hex`. Can someone check?
Priya Rao: Ugh, thanks. I skimmed it yesterday but didn't run it. Could you paste the snippet here?
Alex Chen: Sure — snippet from the PR:
```
client.Generate(ctx, &pb.Request{Prompt: "...", Trace: map[string]string{"trace_id": tid}})
```
Priya Rao: That should be `trace_id_hex` for the dashboard to correlate. The tracehook expects that format.
Jess Kim: I can open a quick patch. Do we want to update the Go snippet and add a callout about the hex vs numeric ID? cc @Michael O'Neill
Michael O'Neill: Yes add a note. Also we should mention the SDK version — older clients accept numeric IDs. Which version does the docs example claim to target?
Alex Chen: Docs currently say "Go SDK v1.4+". The numeric->hex change landed in v1.5. I'll add a short compatibility note.
docs-bot: link-checker: 1 broken link found in PR #789 (console/observability/snippets). See https://ci.redwood/links/789
Priya Rao: Thanks bot. Alex, can you also include a tiny migration snippet showing how to convert a numeric trace id to hex? Example: `fmt.Sprintf("%x", num)`
Alex Chen: Yep — I'll add that and a one-line test to the snip. Patch planned in ~30m.
Jess Kim: Also update the dashboard docs to show the field name. Small UI change request filed on docs-ui #412.
Michael O'Neill: After patch, let's run the trace->dashboard smoke test on staging (route: /docs-demo/trace). I'll take that after lunch.
Alex Chen: Patch opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789 — includes Go fix, migration note, unit test, and updated dashboard field name mention.
Priya Rao: Quick review: code looks fine, left one nit about wording. No blockers.
Jess Kim: LGTM from me, merging once CI passes. :thumbsup:
Michael O'Neill: I'll run the staging smoke test after merge and report back here.
Alex Chen: Thanks all — will followup with any post-merge fixes.
Michael O'Neill: Smoke test passed. Traces are appearing in the dashboard with the corrected hex IDs. Closing loop. :tada:
